if: the document is a credit note or a debit note referred to in section 34
it is issued under rule 53(1A) of the CGST Rules, 2017
then: where the recipient is unregistered, the credit or debit note MUST carry the recipient's name and address, the address of delivery, and the State name and State code
note: One mandatory particular of rule 53(1A)(f), addressable on its own so that a missing field names the clause it breaches.

evidence.quote: name and address of the recipient and the address of delivery, along with the name of State and its code, if such recipient is un-registered;
